svg.title: Plot — TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS against AGE
svg.text: 968 of 1,053 patients have a value on both axes (82 have no AGE; 3 have no TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS); only those are drawn. 2 studies pooled
(luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018, lusc_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018). Each site reports six sums (n, Σx, Σy, Σxy, Σx², Σy²), exact and additive, for Pearson's r and the
regression line; the bin grid uses one shared scale (each site's own extent, pooled) so cells sum correctly. Spearman rank correlation is not reported for a federated plot:
it needs the pooled GLOBAL ranking, which per-site aggregates cannot reconstruct exactly. Point layers — “KRAS mut”: 175 patients, 158 patients drawn as points;
“TP53 mut”: 699 patients, 652 patients drawn as points (58 drawn by an earlier layer). The statistics are over the whole plotted cohort. Darker is more cases; the shade is
logarithmic. The dashed line is the least-squares fit over every case.

svg.title: Plot — TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS by SEX
svg.text: 996 of 1,053 patients have a value on both axes (54 have no SEX; 3 have no TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS); only those are drawn. 2 studies pooled
(luad_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018, lusc_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018). Counts and extremes per group sum exactly; the quartiles are a size-weighted approximation across
sites (it can shift where an outlier bar falls, never a count). Point layers — “KRAS mut”: 175 patients, 164 patients drawn as points. The statistics are over the whole
plotted cohort. Box: quartiles with Tukey whiskers, computed over every case in the group; each name carries its count. Every value is drawn over its box; the jitter is
fixed per case. 5 values lie more than a whisker span past the whiskers and are drawn as a triangle at the frame's edge.
